title: Computer / Summary
linux_source: aggregate of all sections; ini [Sum] item list (computertype os hostname username datetime cputype moboname chipset sysmem spdmodules biostype videoadapter 3dacc monitor audioadapter storage ctrl/disks/smart partitions keyboard mouse gamectrl primaryip primarymac netadapter printer usb ctrls battery dmi* customvar)

title: Computer / DMI
linux_source: /sys/class/dmi/id/*; /sys/firmware/dmi/tables/DMI (root) - BIOS System Chassis Processors Caches MemoryArrays MemoryDevices SystemSlots PortConnectors OnboardDevices PowerSupplies Cooling/Temp/Voltage/Current probes

title: Computer / IPMI
linux_source: /dev/ipmi0 (ipmi_si/ipmi_devintf); ipmitool sel/sdr; absent on desktop boards

title: Computer / Overclock
linux_source: /proc/cpuinfo; cpufreq scaling_max/cur; /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/amd_pstate_*; MSR via /dev/cpu/*/msr (root); DIMM SPD/EXPO via ee1004/spd5118

title: Computer / Sensor
linux_source: /sys/class/hwmon/* (nct6775 it87 asus-ec-sensors k10temp zenpower amdgpu nvme drivetemp spd5118 corsair-psu nzxt-kraken aquacomputer_d5next); thermal_zone; see aida_sensor_ids.txt

title: Motherboard / Motherboard
linux_source: /sys/class/dmi/id/board_*; DMI type 2/9/8; PCIe root ports via /sys/bus/pci

title: Motherboard / SPD
linux_source: /sys/bus/i2c/drivers/ee1004 (DDR4) or spd5118 (DDR5) eeprom; decode JEDEC+XMP/EXPO; decode-dimms

title: Motherboard / Chipset
linux_source: /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:00:* class 0600/0601; amd_df/data-fabric; memory controller via EDAC /sys/devices/system/edac/mc

title: Operating System / Operating System
